properties.proposal: Erection of detached bungalow and detached garage in land to the rear of the existing bungalow (revised scheme of 20/01100/F)
properties.field_evidence: Official Cherwell District Council Planning Register application 20/01906/F. Application Type: Full Development. Status: Application Permitted. Valid date: 30/07/2020. Location: 113 The Moors Kidlington OX5 2AQ. Proposal: Erection of detached bungalow and detached garage in land to the rear of the existing bungalow (revised scheme of 20/01100/F). Decision: Permitted. Decision Issued Date: 14/10/2020. Official documents include Block Plan BP1, dedicated Garage Plan PP1, bungalow floorplan PFP1, roof & drainage plan R1, and amended Proposed Elevations PE2. The official proposal explicitly identifies two distinct new structures: one detached bungalow and one detached garage. The dedicated garage plan independently supports the garage identity; the floorplan/elevations and block plan support the bungalow, and the same official register page lists Building Control application 20/01041/FP for erection of a detached bungalow and detached garage. The existing bungalow is not counted as a new structure. Geometry/materialization is deferred to local OpenCode.
